reviews.text: I love the Lemon Verbena fragrance, so I was excited to try this body wash. The texture is light, and it lathers nicely! The scent is on the lighter side, but still pleasant, which I appreciate since I enjoy this type of fragrance. I'm happy to have tried something new!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意檸檬馬鞭草嘅香味，所以好期待試呢支沐浴露。質地輕盈，起泡好靚！香味偏淡，但都幾舒服，我鍾意呢類香味所以覺得幾好。試到新嘢，開心！

reviews.text: This smells AMAZING! Super refreshing. Leaves skin clean without drying it
reviews.zh: 呢個香味正到爆！超級清爽。洗完乾淨又唔會乾。

reviews.text:
SKINFOODのボディソープどんなものかなと思って購入しました。
夏向けな気がするので少し眠らせておきます。
reviews.zh: 想試下 SKINFOOD 嘅沐浴露係點，所以買咗。感覺似夏天用，所以暫時擺埋一陣先。

reviews.text: Very nice smell and forming very well. I will purchase this again.
reviews.zh: 香味好好，搓出嚟效果好好。我會再回購。

reviews.text: Not for me I guess. I don’t feel the moisturiser effect
reviews.zh: 應該唔啱我。我feel唔到保濕效果。

reviews.text: It smells good, but it doesn't last long. It smells similar to Verveine in L'occitane.
reviews.zh: 香味唔錯，但唔持久。聞落似 L'occitane 嘅 Verveine。

reviews.text: this body wash smells really nice (the perfect amount of lemoniness) and is soft on the skin. i have sensitive skin, and this works perfect for me. highly recommend!!!
reviews.zh: 呢款沐浴露香味真係好聞（檸檬味剛剛好），對皮膚好溫和。我係敏感肌，用落完全冇問題。非常推薦！！！

reviews.text: I like it. I love Olive Young. The delivery speed was better than I thought.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意。我好鍾意 Olive Young。送貨速度比想像中快。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
